_why: AGENTS.md §26 (18.0.0, ACTIVE) and the registry row watchlist_membership (proposed): watchlist_items is the ONE
membership list; membership changes only by the CIO curator and operator commands; everything else contributes
candidates. These rules are evaluated by scripts/lib/cio_prospect_watchlist_rules.py inside the cio_prospect shadow
build and PROPOSE membership changes only. Nothing here writes watchlist_items. Applying them to what is ranked onto
Watch is an operator decision (AGENTS.md §17, §26.3: 'Changing what a surface ranks stays §17').

ways_in._rule: Every membership names exactly one origin and a non-empty reason. A candidate with no reason is refused.

operator_star.requires: operator star (operator_starred_symbols or watchlist_items origin operator_star)

held_position.requires: positions_current row with qty > 0 through the approved positions reader

operator_directive.requires: an active ticker watch directive (watch_directives, read through the watch_intelligence projection) — the operator asked to watch it (silo audit 2026-10-23)

cio_curator.requires: opportunity projection stance BUY_SETUP/ADD or conviction >= min_conviction

cio_thesis.requires: cio_theses stance watch/buy with a thesis version

existing_member.requires: already an active watchlist_items row (legacy membership, reason carried)

ways_out._rule: A non-protected member is proposed out when its evidence expires (expires_at + grace) or it is invalidated. Protected members (operator adds, operator stars, held positions) are NEVER auto-dropped: they are flagged for operator review instead.
invalidated_by: stage exit older than exit_retention_days without re_entry

size_cap_per_stage._rule: When a stage holds more non-protected members than its cap, the lowest-conviction non-protected members are proposed out (ties: oldest evidence first). Protected members count toward the stage but are never proposed out.
